info.name: Notification
info.description:
Every endpoint of the Notification service, in an order that runs start to finish. Requests capture ids into collection variables, so a full run needs no manual input beyond base_url.

UUID v7 is generated in the collection pre-request script because Postman's {{$guid}} is v4 and the contract rejects it.

The history is empty on a fresh service because a notification is only ever created by consuming an event from another service, and the contract exposes no route to inject one.
